messages:
anika: Quick thought 1: propose a "Quantized Model Bundle" (QMB) as a packaging add-on: customers opt into lower-cost quantized model variants + an SLA tier for inference. goal: offer predictable unit-cost savings in exchange for constraints (no fallbacks to full-precision without notice).
joel: interesting. customers who can tolerate occasional quality delta might love this. what are the contract constraints?
lena: from sales: want clear migration and opt-out rules. shouldn't be able to silently flip to full-precision during spikes (that kills cost math). propose: bundle requires a 90d minimum and a 30d notice to revert.
marco: infra note: runtime needs to support pinned model variants per customer and an automatic rollback plan if perf/regression detected. engineering estimate: 3 sprints for variant gating + per-account config.
finance-bot: rough pricing: quantized variants ~30-50% lower unit cost in synthetic tests. propose three tiers: Q-lite (-30%), Q-standard (-40%), Q-prem (-50%) with increasing restrictions on fallback and longer min terms. need finance to model revenue recognition.
anika: product tradeoffs: plus = clear cost saving, easier capacity planning; minus = complexity in model onboarding and added QA/evals. Launch criteria (MVP): 1) pricing bands + contract language, 2) model variant pinning in runtime, 3) console flags showing "quantized" usage, 4) QA regimen + eval baseline for each model variant.
joel: sales asks: allow a 30d demo on Q-standard to prove quality to customers. also include a visible "quality delta" report in the console so CFOs can justify cost.
lena: migration: customers on dedicated or burst credits can opt in with pro-rated conversion; we must include an escape clause if quality regresses beyond agreed thresholds.
marco: ops safety: add automatic rollback if model outputs fail regression checks on sampling (e.g., BLEU/embedding drift) for 3 consecutive days. also set capacity cap per variant to avoid noisy neighbors.
finance-bot: risk: lowering price per token can shrink ARR if many migrate; mitigation: require commitment terms and minimum spend bands. also track conversion rate from demo to paid.
anika: proposed MVP tickets: PRIC-QMB-001 pricing bands & contract, PRIC-QMB-002 runtime variant pinning, PRIC-QMB-003 console UX + quality reports, PRIC-QMB-004 QA/evals pipeline.
joel: KPIs: % commit migrated to QMB, avg unit cost reduction, quality-regression incidents, number of rollbacks, pilot conversion rate.
lena: pilot plan: 4 customers (2 inference-cost-sensitive startups, 1 mid-market, 1 enterprise with predictable usage). joel to line up.
anika: next steps: joel to shortlist pilots by Tue, marco to confirm engineering ETA, finance to model revenue scenarios, i'll draft contract + FAQ by EOW. @pricing-bot create epic. :rocket:
pricing-bot: Created epic PRIC-QMB (https://go/repo/PRIC-QMB) - owners: anika, joel, marco.
